podcast.title: Classically Trained Musician
podcast.body: Mary Guibert, the mother of Jeff Buckley, was a classically trained musician who played both piano and cello. "Mom was a classically trained musician playing piano and cello."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Marriage to Tim Buckley
podcast.body: Mary Guibert met Tim Buckley in French class in 1964 and married him in 1965. They divorced about a month before their son, Jeff, was born. "In 1964, he met Mary Gebert in French class in high school and eventually married her in 1965. However, that didn't work out. And about a month before their son was born, Tim and Mary divorced."

xref.title: Early Influences and Musical Development
xref.body: Jeff Buckley, born to Tim Buckley and Mary Guibert, met his father only once. His mother was a classically trained musician, while his stepfather introduced him to bands like Pink Floyd, Jimi Hendrix, The Who, Led Zeppelin, and Queen. Jeff picked up the guitar at age 5, discovered Rush, Kiss, and various prog rock bands, and received his first electric guitar at age 12. "One of the people Tim left behind was his eight-year-old son, Jeff, who admitted his father only once. Mom was a classically trained musician playing piano and cello. Meanwhile, Jeff's death father was into Pink Floyd, Jimmy Hendrix, the who led Zeppelin and Queen.
